item.text: {"schema_version":"1.0","formal_eligible":false,"scheme_id":"direct-load-applicability-ranked-first-docs-v1","parent_scheme_id":"direct-load-broad-first-docs-v0","build_policy":"One task-blind Codex builder extracts reusable, source-located spec-alignment memories from the same suite-owned first-document corpus, assigns each entry a narrow applicability condition and an explicit override boundary, deduplicates overlapping guidance, and ranks entries by cross-case relevance.","consumption_policy":"applicability_gated_direct_load: before drafting, load only the highest-ranked entries whose applicability conditions match the task phase and evidence; treat repository and user evidence as authoritative over Memory, and require an evidence-grounded completeness pass independent of Memory.","delta":["Replace broad loading of the full Memory set with applicability-gated loading; the observed trace used 4 entries while rejecting 19 and overriding 1.","Add explicit override boundaries during Memory construction because one applicable-looking general rule conflicted with task evidence.","Deduplicate and rank loaded guidance to reduce attention burden while retaining source locators and the existing first-document corpus.","Add a Memory-independent completeness pass because both judged projections retained critical omissions despite relevant Memory use.","Do not encode the omitted case details; the adjustment remains suite-global and task-blind."],"hypothesis":"Loading a smaller, applicability-ranked set of reusable memories, with explicit override boundaries and an independent evidence-based completeness pass, may preserve the observed burden reduction while reducing attention dilution and critical specification omissions.","forbidden_case_specific_atoms":["H02","feat-510","tool_approval_model","unified tool approval model","统一工具审批模型"]}
